description: Like blue_drawer_end_right.json, but blue on the center third at (0.175, -0.12), right in front of the open drawer, where the push_into_drawer segments of CALVIN D start (x 0.04-0.22, y -0.09 to -0.15). One step: only the end state, the blue block lying in the open drawer, so the policy may get it there any way it likes (grip and place, or push it off the table edge into the drawer, CALVIN's push_into_drawer). The conditions are the release_drawer poses. Success = the block rests on the drawer floor, whether or not it was held (the default ["drawer", "released"] would also count a block that fell to the floor, z < 0.40). No scale or alpha, the plan sets them (plan_blue_drawer_end.json). Make it with dynaguide_scripts/make_task.py
